info.title: Creating incremental backups with send and receive

abstract.para: Snapshots become a basis for backups when you combine them with the Btrfs send and receive feature. The command btrfs send calculates the difference between two read-only snapshots of the same subvolume and writes it to a file or to standard output. The command btrfs receive applies the result to a snapshot on the target side.

listitem.para: Btrfs file systems exist on the source side and on the target side.
The data resides in a Btrfs subvolume.
The snapshots on the source side are read-only.
